description: This file defines the WorkShift entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing work shift data with properties such as id, name, hours per day, start time, and end time. It uses Doctrine ORM for mapping to the database and includes getter and setter methods.

classes.name: WorkShift
classes.description: Entity class representing a work shift with properties such as id, name, hours per day, start time, and end time, including ORM mappings and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the work shift.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the work shift.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the work shift.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the work shift.

methods.name: getHoursPerDay
methods.description: Returns the number of hours per day for this shift.

methods.name: setHoursPerDay
methods.description: Sets the number of hours per day for this shift.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the shift.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the shift.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the shift.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the shift.
